note: From the Alaska Division of Elections' official sample ballots for House Districts 27 and 30 in the Third Judicial District. Every Matanuska-Susitna Borough voter is in the Third Judicial District and votes on the same superior and district court retention questions; the Fourth Judicial District part of House District 30 is the Denali Borough precincts (Anderson-Clear, Cantwell, Denali Park, Healy). Each judge on a retention ballot is the sitting judge. Mat-Su Borough assembly, mayor and borough propositions, and city offices in Palmer and Wasilla, are decided in the October local election, not on this ballot. Not shown: State House and Senate districts. Supreme Court Justice Jude Pate's retention and Ballot Measures 2 and 3 are statewide and not repeated here. Check your official sample ballot.
